intro: The SNOW+ seals waste into disposable liners and treats odour with a titanium dioxide photocatalyst instead of carbon. Its safety system is cautious by design, which owners sometimes mistake for a fault.

facts.text: Connects over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; basic operation works without a phone.
Waste is collected and sealed in disposable PetSnowy liners.
Odour is handled by a TiO2 photocatalyst rather than a carbon filter.
A built-in litter-control walkway with a mat reduces tracking.

symptoms.title: Waste is not sealed into the liner
symptoms.summary: Waste collects but the liner does not close around it.
causes: The liner is not loaded the way the manual shows.

fixes.detail: Fit PetSnowy's own self-sealing liners; the sealing depends on them.
Reinstall the liner following PetSnowy's instructions exactly.

symptoms.escalate: If genuine, correctly loaded liners still do not seal, contact PetSnowy support.

symptoms.title: Cleaning pauses or does not start
symptoms.summary: The cycle stops or waits while a cat is nearby.
causes: SnowSafe+ pauses cleaning the moment a cat enters.

fixes.detail: Wait for the cat to leave and the area to clear; the cycle resumes on its own.

symptoms.escalate: If it pauses with no cat present, follow the common "will not cycle" steps.

symptoms.title: App shows the SNOW+ offline
symptoms.summary: The app loses the unit, though it still works locally.
causes: The unit joins 2.4 GHz networks only.

fixes.detail: Make sure the SNOW+ is on a 2.4 GHz network. Basic cleaning continues without the app in the meantime.

symptoms.escalate: If it will not stay connected on 2.4 GHz near the router, contact PetSnowy.
